name: Fighter
description: Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat. Fighters excel at overcoming difficult odds through discipline and versatility, and can hold the line, break the enemy's, or do a little of both — living weapons, thinking and acting on their feet.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: Focus on raw physical power to deal devastating hits.

grants.name: Improved Critical
grants.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

grants.name: Remarkable Athlete
grants.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. Your running long jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

grants.name: Additional Fighting Style
grants.description: Learn a second Fighting Style option of your choice, different from the one you already know.

grants.name: Superior Critical
grants.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20.

grants.name: Survivor
grants.description: At the start of each of your turns, regain HP equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your HP left and aren't at 0 HP.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: Use combat maneuvers powered by superiority dice to control the battlefield.

grants.name: Combat Superiority
grants.description: You gain 4 Superiority Dice (d8s). When you roll initiative and have no Superiority Dice left, you regain one. All expended dice are regained on a short or long rest.

grants.name: Combat Maneuvers
grants.description: Learn 3 maneuvers. Whenever you use one, roll your Superiority Die and add it to the effect; the die is expended on use.

options.name: Ambush
options.description: Add your Superiority Die to a Stealth check or to an initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.description: Swap places with a willing creature within 5 ft.; add the die to your AC or theirs until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Brace
options.description: Reaction: when a creature moves into your reach, make a melee attack against it, adding the die to the damage.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.description: Forgo one attack to direct an ally; it can use its reaction to attack, adding the die to its damage.

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or drops an item of your choice.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; the next attack against the target by someone else has advantage before your next turn.

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: Add the die to your AC while moving, without provoking opportunity attacks.

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.description: Bonus action to feint against a creature within 5 ft.; you have advantage on your next attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: Extend your melee reach by 5 ft. for one attack, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; an ally can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Parry
options.description: Reaction: when hit by a melee attack, reduce the damage by the die roll plus your Dexterity modifier.

options.name: Precision Attack
options.description: Add the die to an attack roll, before or after the roll is made.

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or is pushed up to 15 ft. away.

options.name: Rally
options.description: Bonus action: choose an ally, who gains temporary hit points equal to the die roll plus your Fighter level.

options.name: Riposte
options.description: Reaction: when a creature misses you with a melee attack, make a melee attack against it, adding the die to damage on a hit.

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: Hit: choose another creature within 5 ft. of the original target; if the attack would hit it too, it takes damage equal to the die roll.

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: Hit: add the die to damage; target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone.

grants.name: Student of War
grants.description: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

grants.name: Know Your Enemy
grants.description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature outside combat, learn how it compares to you: whether it's your equal, superior, or inferior in one or more of Strength, AC, current HP, or class levels (DM's choice).

grants.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d10)
grants.description: Your Superiority Dice turn into d10s.

grants.name: Relentless
grants.description: When you roll initiative and have no Superiority Dice left, you regain one Superiority Die.

grants.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d12)
grants.description: Your Superiority Dice turn into d12s.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: Combine martial mastery with arcane spells from the wizard spell list.

grants.name: Spellcasting
grants.description: Learn wizard cantrips and spells (mostly from the abjuration and evocation schools), cast using Intelligence. See the Spells step for your known spells and slots.

grants.name: Weapon Bond
grants.description: Bond with up to two weapons in a short ritual; you can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon unless incapacitated, and can summon a bonded weapon to your hand as a bonus action.

grants.name: War Magic
grants.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

grants.name: Eldritch Strike
grants.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on its next save against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

grants.name: Arcane Charge
grants.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see, before or after the additional action.

grants.name: Improved War Magic
grants.description: You can use War Magic when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, not just a cantrip.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.description: Use psionic energy to augment your physical attacks and protect your allies.

grants.name: Psionic Power
grants.description: Gain a pool of Psionic Energy dice (d6s) that fuel three abilities: Protective Field (reaction, reduce damage to yourself or a nearby creature), Psi-Powered Leap (bonus action, fly speed and jump distance for a minute), and Telekinetic Movement (action, move an object or creature you can see within 30 ft.). Dice are spent to fuel each use and are all regained on a long rest.

grants.name: Telekinetic Adept
grants.description: Gain two more uses drawn from your Psionic Energy dice: Psionic Strike (add a die to a weapon attack's damage as force damage) and Telekinetic Thrust (push, pull, or knock a creature prone with a hit).

grants.name: Guarded Mind
grants.description: Resistance to psychic damage, and at the start of your turn you can end one effect on yourself that made you charmed or frightened.

grants.name: Bulwark of Force
grants.description: Reaction: expend a Psionic Energy die to grant half cover to yourself and up to two creatures within 30 ft. of you against a source you can see, until the start of your next turn.

grants.name: Telekinetic Master
grants.description: Cast telekinesis without spending a spell slot, once per long rest, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice) as the spellcasting ability.

grants.name: Skill Proficiencies
grants.description: Choose 2 skills from the fighter list.

grants.name: Fighting Style
grants.description: Adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

grants.name: Second Wind
grants.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. Two uses per long rest; regain a use on a short rest.

grants.name: Weapon Mastery
grants.description: Choose 3 weapons you have proficiency with. You gain that weapon's mastery property whenever you attack with it. Swap choices after a long rest.

grants.name: Action Surge (1/rest)
grants.description: Take one additional action on your turn, once per short or long rest.

grants.name: Tactical Mind
grants.description: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind (no action required) to add a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus to the check, potentially turning the failure into a success, instead of regaining hit points.

grants.name: Martial Archetype
grants.description: Choose a Fighter subclass, gaining features from it at this level and again at later levels.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Extra Attack
grants.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Martial Archetype Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Indomitable (1/long rest)
grants.description: Reroll a failed saving throw. Once per long rest.

grants.name: Martial Archetype Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Extra Attack (2)
grants.description: Attack three times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Indomitable (2/long rest)
grants.description: Reroll a failed saving throw. Twice per long rest.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Martial Archetype Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Action Surge (2/rest)
grants.description: Use Action Surge twice per short or long rest, but only once per turn.

grants.name: Indomitable (3/long rest)
grants.description: Reroll a failed saving throw. Three times per long rest.

grants.name: Martial Archetype Feature
grants.description: Gain a feature from your chosen subclass.

grants.name: Ability Score Improvement
grants.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1 each, to a maximum of 20 (or take a feat).

grants.name: Extra Attack (3)
grants.description: Attack four times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
